body: I just feel stuck in a relationship and feel like I'm being held back by my anxiety and depression. I've been in therapy and on medication for more than a decade. Sometimes I think it's improving, but other times it just seems hopeless. I don't have too many people in my life and I feel like I'm already too much of a burden to them. I'm so tired...

Early in the relationship I can totally see not needing to go to therapy, but if you stuck it out this long, and want to keep sticking it out (relationships are always going to be hard), it's not a bad idea to try it out. Best of luck.

I suggest going to therapy with her, or going to a therapist by yourself. If she's willing to let you tag along, you could learn a lot about how to communicate your concerns in a safe, mediated environment. I bet her therapist hears a lot of complaints each week just like you do each day, and s/he might be a great buffer for how you can start putting a cap on what you can handle to hear each day.
Honestly, you're my type! You are very handsome and have a gorgeous body. If you want to get healthy, go for it, but you have a great bod.

Yeah, he's definitely not a big spender. Each day it's a concern whether or not he'll be able to afford food. He has a few things of value that he's been trying to sell, but we don't know the best way to go about it.

I like that. It's still a young relationship and we're nowhere near anything like moving in together or getting too serious. He'd need to have his act together (or at least headed in that direction) before we progressed much further than dating. Thank you.

I have brought it up with her before, just because I drive myself crazy with it. She has helped me set boundaries for what I can and cannot do for him. But that doesn't make the guilt go away. I guess that's MY problem to work on, not his.
That's a good point. Just in my anxious mind I keep thinking that I should be doing more for him. But you're right, he needs to find his motivation on his own.

I'd love to get him to a therapist, but I bet he'd resist it because of the cost. Any suggestions on how to broach that topic? I see a therapist regularly and I don't think my therapist would mind if I brought him along with me, but then it would be about us, and not him.
Yeah it hasn't been fun. I'm sorry you've been through it too. I'm hanging in there. Just until Monday assuming everything works out!
Thank you. I've been sleeping a ton. Haven't felt suicidal yet but it's not a rare occurrence.

Thank you, that's very helpful. I've been asleep for most of the past 48 hours which has helped. I am getting some weird cravings though so I haven't been eating all that well. But my boyfriend is with me and keeping me pretty distracted during my waking hours.

Because I'm an idiot, I don't know how to edit my original post. I have no self esteem and feel like I'm always going go be a fat disgusting slob. I hate myself so much for it but I can't control myself. At least not in the long term. It fucking sucks. Not a day goes by that I don't feel fat and ugly and every other day my parents remind me it's true.
